India's Missile Development Plans Spark Debate on Privatization

The Indian government is considering a plan to allow private companies to build missiles, sparking debate about its implications for national security and the defense industry. The move aims to increase efficiency and reduce costs, but critics worry it may compromise the country's ability to develop advanced missile technology. As India prepares to join the Missile Technology Control Regime (MTCR), this plan raises questions about the balance between economic benefits and strategic interests.
